title: Crows Remember Your Face for Years

scenes.text: Crows remember your face. For years.
Scientists in Seattle wore a creepy mask while trapping and tagging crows.
Afterwards, any time someone wore that mask, crows screamed at them and dive-bombed them.
Crows that were never trapped did it too. They learned the face from the others.
Years later, the crows still recognised the mask, long after most of the original birds were gone.
So be nice to crows. They're keeping a list.

description:
In a University of Washington study, crows learned to recognise a 'dangerous' mask, taught other crows about it, and kept scolding it for years.
Crows don't forget a face.
Have crows ever singled you out?
